evidence: Static review of the frozen bytes; this row needs no runtime measurement. instruction.md (683 bytes, 5 lines, pure ASCII, single trailing newline, sha256 4848dc69...) was read in full: no misspelling, no duplicated paragraph, no leftover template text (the template's only line is 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt the agent receives.' and it is gone). Case-insensitive grep over instruction.md and the six notes for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|lorem|C:\|/Users/|/home/|F:/|turing|rubric|criterion|judge|golden|oracle returned no match (rc=1); no non-ASCII bytes in any of the seven files. Paths named in the brief are real container paths, not another machine's: instruction.md:3 '/instructions' and '/assets/seed_data.json' match environment/Dockerfile:14-15 ('COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/'), and instruction.md:5 '/app' matches Dockerfile:25 and integration.md:3. Internal consistency: instruction.md:3 'the six notes' = exactly six files in environment/instructions; 'there is no starter app to finish' and 'describes the starting scope' agree with integration.md:7 and seed_data.json ('snippets': []); 'serve the workspace at /' agrees with integration.md:3; 'without signing in' agrees with overview.md:3 and policy.md:3; a single run budget value ('five-second', behaviour.md:5) and a single refresh value ('about five seconds', behaviour.md:11) for a different thing; one seed path; one port (0.0.0.0:3000); one default DB path (/app/app.db with DB_PATH override, integration.md:9). The six notes were read in full: no spelling errors; British spelling (behaviour, colour, coloured) is used consistently and instruction.md contains no word that would conflict. Apparent tensions examined and found to be qualified statements, not contradictions: ui.md:3 forbids textarea/input/contenteditable 'as the document surface' while allowing 'a small input solely for keyboard or clipboard plumbing'; policy.md:3 and ui.md:3,15 both allow parser/formatter libraries while forbidding ready-made editors; security.md:5 refuses eval/Function/workers while behaviour.md:3 says the browser may execute 'supported' code. The task name spelling 'colderwater' (task.toml:5) versus the run label 'coldwater' does not appear in any agent-facing text and the assignment declares the name not an identity defect. Probes: a broken-app or conforming-alternative counterexample for this row would need a typo or contradiction that steers a builder to a wrong path, value or behaviour; none was found.
